request: Boston to London Heathrow on February 22nd. Economy is fine, but please get me the British Airways economy fare that I can upgrade later with my miles.

trip.purpose: Customer data migration workshop in London

must_keep.quote: Full Y fares, or upgradeable fares, are not allowed to be booked.

International travel is to be by lowest possible airfare available. Any international travel exceeding 8 hours (whether a single segment or multiple segments combined) can be booked in an upgradeable fare or, with the prior approval of the traveler's Vice-President, in business class.
must_keep.why: the international rule: lowest fare; business over 8 hours with the Vice-President's prior approval

must_keep.quote: All airline tickets must be booked at the lowest available airfare as determined by Concur or the Travel Desk (subject to the parameters defined in this section).
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest available airfare

distractors.quote: Employees may utilize their own frequent flier miles to upgrade fares, where applicable.
distractors.why: the traveller may use miles on the ticket bought; it does not choose the fare

design_notes: Upgradeable fares are not allowed to be booked (line 433). The only exception, international travel exceeding 8 hours (lines 402-404), does not reach a 405-minute nonstop. The lowest fare; the traveller may still use miles on it where the airline allows (lines 404-405).
